verdict.rationale: The only evidence is the GNOME Activities/Super-key search-and-launch feature, which supports keyboard-driven app launching but says nothing about hotkey-driven window management, tiling, or entire-system keyboard navigation. Missing for 10: documentation of keyboard shortcuts for window snapping/tiling/workspace switching, evidence of full keyboard-only operability without mouse fallback, and any independent hands-on confirmation of keyboard-centric workflows.
